serving.notes: generation_config.json sets max_length 2048 and token ids, not temperature. Training max sequence length is 512. Batch size 4 with gradient accumulation 4, effective batch 16. The published file is model.safetensors with 1,100,048,384 F16 parameters and there is no adapter_config.json, so the upload is full weights; the Hub API still labels library_name peft and base_model:adapter. The card's GitHub link text is github.com/vikasparmar444/medical-llm-finetune and the href is https://github.com/vikasparmar444; both returned 404. The card says 180k MedQA samples are available; the Hub dataset viewer shows 10,178 rows. Dataset answers are exam options such as 'E: Nitrofurantoin'; the card's printed examples are prose answers. No evaluation numbers are reported.
